A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 25 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-corellia-PC-Errata-2018-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Corellia (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): The game text changes: “(with one pilot)” is added after “Side:''' Your ''Falcon''”. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (349 × 489 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
